name: Minimalist HUD
description: Removes unnecessary HUD clutter that can't be disabled via the menu.

options.name: Minimalist | DEFINITIVE EDITION
options.tooltip: Minimalist HUD - The definitive edition of this mod. All the base changes of this mod built on top of Heritage UI hud. Dot crosshair no transparency. I've changed some of the freelancer icons back to green, the SA indicator his hidden when green, and the best part - customizeable action prompts. You can edit the manifest.json to decide for a bunch of different prompts if you want to hide the button, the top text, or both from the interaction hud.

options.name: Minimalist | DEFINITIVE EDITION (v3.230)
options.tooltip: Minimalist HUD - Definitive edition for users (like me) who want to stay on the old patch since 3.240.1 breaks too much stuff. Includes Hide Exit Icon, don't check that option with this.

options.name: Throw | Dot Reticle
options.tooltip: Changes the thrown object reticle into a dot

options.name: Throw | Hide Impact
options.tooltip: Hides the throw aiming landing circle animation

options.name: Hide Passport icon (Safehouse)
options.tooltip: Remove Passport icon from the freelancer safehouse

options.name: Hide Interaction Outline
options.tooltip: Hides the white outline including around NPCs. In-game menu option only affects items.

options.name: Hide Suspect Phone Fx
options.tooltip: Removes the pulsing circle and camera filter from the freelancer suspect burner phones.

options.name: Minimal Instinct
options.tooltip: No instinct filter, no outlines, more faint NPC highlights

options.name: Hide Skeleton
options.tooltip: Hides the cartoonish skeleton showing when people get electrocuted. Like HM2016

options.name: Fix - stadia icons
options.tooltip: Check this box ONLY IF you're not using Heritage UI AND have hide exit icon unchecked

options.name: Minimalist
options.tooltip: Drag body and open/close door fully hidden (unlock door still shows). Simplified Pick Up and Disguise prompts (only shows weapon name and disguise name), many other common prompts are button-only. You can see what's changed in the manifest.json. The characters prefixing the localisation entries determine what is hidden from the UI.

options.name: Minimalist - text only
options.tooltip: Custom example config with all text prompts. Looks pretty clean.

options.name: Bare Bones
options.tooltip: Extra minimal button prompts. Pacify, Subdue, Disguise, Drag body, Open door, completely hidden from interaction HUD, among others.

options.name: YOUR Custom Version
options.tooltip: Placeholder for your own customized version of button prompts. Just edit the manifest.json file, I made this so easy anyone with a text editor can customize these prompts.
